svg.title: Two Products, One Enforced Baseline
svg.desc: Secret Protection groups secret scanning, push protection and custom patterns, Code Security groups code scanning, Autofix and dependency review, and an enforced security configuration applies the chosen features to a class of repositories.
svg.text: Buy what you need, then enforce it across a class of repositories.
Applied to repositories with tier=critical or tier=standard; owners can't turn features off
Reports coverage and alerts; it doesn't enforce anything
